panels.title: Cache-read ratio (median)
panels.description: ADR-008's lever: cache reads are ~10% of fresh input, so this number is the difference between 1x and 6x on the same conversation. Phase 1 measured 93.7% over 30 turns against a 70% bar.

panels.title: Cache-read ratio by pool
panels.description: A drop in one pool only is usually a prompt-assembly change (something injected into the stable prefix); a drop everywhere is usually the provider.

panels.title: COGS $/hour by pool
panels.description: Dollars, never percent (ADR-007). Read next to the unpriced-calls panel: this number is only as complete as the price table.

panels.title: Unpriced calls/min
panels.description: Calls whose model has no configured price. Anything above zero means the COGS panel understates cost — the gateway reports the gap rather than guessing a price (docs/21 §M21.2).

panels.title: Dropped metric samples
panels.description: Above zero means a label went unbounded (an id reached a metric) or a call site has wrong label arity. The dashboard above is degraded while this is non-zero.

panels.title: Provider errors by kind
panels.description: Failover health. `provider_retryable` climbing while `model_unavailable` stays flat is the chain doing its job; both climbing together is an outage.

panels.title: Model call latency p99 (establishment)
panels.description: Time to establish a stream, not to finish one — docs/11's overhead budget is <3ms non-streaming, and a long generation would drown it.

panels.title: Route decisions by rule
panels.description: Is the router earning its keep. A policy where everything matches the catch-all rule is a policy that is not routing.

panels.title: Turn stop reasons
panels.description: docs/21: budget stops climbing is a UX problem brewing. `max_steps` rising means the loop is thrashing, not that users got more ambitious.

panels.title: Sandbox-seconds by tier
panels.description: The second metered good (docs/17). T2 and T3 seconds cost real money; T0 seconds do not.

panels.title: Tokens by disposition
panels.description: Cache counts are subsets of input (see the CONVENTION note on `Usage`) — `input` already includes `cache_read`, so do not add them.

panels.title: Reducer tokens removed by strategy
panels.description: Volume, not the saving. The dollar figure (`panday_reducer_saved_usd_total`) needs the price table in the loop (M11.4); until then this panel says how much text was cut, which is not the same claim (ADR-007).
